code: /// Advances the simulation by one tick.
/// A tick runs as a fixed sequence of phases across the whole population: basic needs,
/// social actions, upkeep, shelter ownership, then cleanup. Every entity finishes one phase before
/// any entity starts the next, so social actions always see everyone's final position for the tick.

tryConceive.name: TryConceive
code: /// Lets an entity look for a partner nearby and, if it finds one, try to conceive a child with them.
/// <param name="entity">The entity looking for a partner.</param>
/// <param name="population">The current number of entities in the simulation, used for the population limit.</param>
/// <returns><c>true</c> if a child was conceived and the mother is now pregnant; otherwise <c>false</c>.</returns>
/// Each entity tries to mate at most once per tick. When several partners qualify, one is chosen
/// at random. If the pair does not conceive, neither pays anything, but both have used their try.
/// Both parents' recovery periods start at conception, so the mother recovers while she carries.
public bool TryConceive(Entity entity, int population)
Entity mother = entity.Sex == Sex.Female ? entity : partner;
Entity father = entity.Sex == Sex.Female ? partner : entity;

deliver.name: TryDeliver
code: /// Delivers a pregnant mother's child if it is due.
/// <param name="mother">The entity that may be giving birth.</param>
/// <param name="childId">The id to give the child if one is born.</param>
/// <returns>The newborn with its father's id, or <c>null</c> if no child was born this tick.</returns>
/// The child is placed in a cell with room, chosen from the mother's cell and the eight around
/// it, and starts with the child energy both parents paid for at conception. If every one of
/// those cells is full, the pregnancy ends and the child does not survive; check
public (Entity Child, int FatherId)? TryDeliver(Entity mother, int childId)
if (!TryChooseBirthPosition(mother, out (int X, int Y) position))
Entity child = CreateChild(pregnancy, childId, position.X, position.Y);

inherit.name: InheritTraits
code: /// Builds a child's traits by blending both parents' traits.
/// <param name="childSex">The child's sex, chosen just before, which decides its strength range.</param>
/// Each trait is the average of the two parents. Impulsiveness is then nudged up or down by a
/// random amount no larger than the mutation setting, staying between 0 and 1. Strength comes from
/// <see cref="StrengthRules.Inherit"/>, using its own random stream so it never shifts the
private EntityTraits InheritTraits(EntityTraits mother, EntityTraits father, Sex childSex)
return new EntityTraits(maxEnergy, lifespan, impulsiveness, strength);

RelationshipGain.doc: Gets or sets how much the relationship between two nearby entities rises each tick they are both fed. Must not be negative.

RelationshipLoss.doc: Gets or sets how much an entity's relationship with a cellmate falls when the entity goes short of food and the cellmate got a full meal. Must not be negative.

RelationshipDecay.doc: Gets or sets the share of every relationship that fades each tick, from 0 to 1.

RelationshipFloor.doc: Gets or sets the size below which a relationship is treated as zero and forgotten. Must not be negative.

FriendPull.doc: Gets or sets the strongest pull drawing entities toward cells in or next to friends, in food units per unit of positive relationship. Zero switches the pull off. Must not be negative.

HungerSilencesFriends.doc: Gets or sets a value indicating whether a hungry entity ignores its friends when choosing where to move. When on, an entity whose energy is below HungerThreshold feels no pull toward friends at all and goes purely for food. When off, the pull fades in a straight line as energy falls.

HungerThreshold.doc: Gets or sets the share of its max energy, from 0 to 1, below which an entity becomes hungry and starts eating. Once it starts, it keeps eating until it reaches SatiatedThreshold. A value of 1 means entities eat whenever they have room.

MaturityAge.doc: Gets or sets the age in ticks an entity must reach before it can reproduce. Must not be negative. Zero means entities can reproduce from birth.

ReproductionThreshold.doc: Gets or sets the energy an entity must have, right after eating, to be able to reproduce. Must be greater than ReproductionCost. The default matches the default hunger threshold on a max energy of 10. The scenario baseline uses its own value.

ReproductionCooldown.doc: Gets or sets the number of ticks both parents must wait after conceiving before they can reproduce again. A mother also cannot conceive while pregnant. Must not be negative.

ConceptionChance.doc: Gets or sets the chance, from 0 to 1, that a willing pair conceives a child when they meet.

CousinConceptionFactor.doc: Gets or sets how much the conception chance is scaled for distant kin, from 0 to 1. Distant kin are cousins, and aunts or uncles with their nieces or nephews. A value of 0.5 means they are half as likely to conceive as unrelated pairs. The name predates aunts and uncles being included.

ReproductionCost.doc: Gets or sets the energy each parent pays to reproduce. Must be greater than zero.

GestationTicks.doc: Gets or sets the number of ticks a mother carries a child before it is born. Must not be negative. Zero means the child is born in the same tick it is conceived.

ChildEnergy.doc: Gets or sets the energy a newborn starts with. Must be greater than zero and no more than what both parents pay together, so that reproduction never creates energy from nothing.

MaxEntitiesPerCell.doc: Gets or sets the most living entities that can share one cell. A pregnant mother counts as one. Entities will not move into a full cell, and a child born when every cell around its mother is full does not survive. Must be at least 1.

MaxPopulation.doc: Gets or sets the population size at which reproduction stops. This is a safety limit against runaway growth.

GestationMetabolism.doc: Gets or sets the extra energy a pregnant mother spends each tick on top of normal metabolism. Must not be negative.

GestationMoveCost.doc: Gets or sets the extra energy a pregnant mother spends each time she moves, on top of the normal move cost. Must not be negative.

SightRange.doc: Gets or sets how far an entity can see to spot things, in cells, counting a diagonal step as one. A chilled entity spots shelters this far away. The default of 1 means an entity only sees the eight cells around it. This does not change how far an entity looks when it weighs food and friends; see ForagingRange. Must be at least 1.

ForagingRange.doc: Gets or sets how far an entity looks, in cells, when it weighs food and friends to decide where to move. It scores every cell this close and steps one cell toward the best. The default of 1 means it compares the eight cells around it. Impulse moves always pick among the eight neighbors. Must be at least 1.

entity.name: Traits
entity.doc: Gets the heritable values this entity was born with.

entity.name: Sex
entity.doc: Gets the entity's sex, which is fixed at birth.

entity.name: Id
entity.doc: Gets the number that identifies this entity.

entity.name: X
entity.doc: Gets the column of the cell this entity occupies.

entity.name: Y
entity.doc: Gets the row of the cell this entity occupies.

entity.name: Energy
entity.doc: Gets the entity's current energy.

entity.name: MaxEnergy
entity.doc: Gets the most energy this entity can hold. This is a shortcut to the value in Traits.

entity.name: Age
entity.doc: Gets the number of ticks this entity has lived.

entity.name: MaxAge
entity.doc: Gets the number of ticks this entity lives before dying of old age. This is a shortcut to the lifespan in Traits.

entity.name: LastBirthTick
entity.doc: Gets the tick count when this entity last conceived a child, or null if it never has.

entity.name: Pregnancy
entity.doc: Gets the child this entity is carrying, or null if it is not pregnant.

entity.name: IsPregnant
entity.doc: Gets a value indicating whether this entity is carrying a child.

entity.name: IsRefilling
entity.doc: Gets a value indicating whether the entity is partway through refilling: it dropped below the hunger threshold and has not yet eaten its way back up to the satiated threshold.

entity.name: GroupTag
entity.doc: Gets the tag of the group this entity feels it belongs to, or zero before it joins a simulation.

entity.name: Warmth
entity.doc: Gets the entity's current body warmth, from 0 to MaxWarmth.

entity.name: IsWarming
entity.doc: Gets a value indicating whether the entity is partway through warming up: it fell below the chilled threshold and has not yet climbed back to full warmth.

entity.name: KnownShelters
entity.doc: Gets the cells of every shelter this entity has spent a tick in, oldest first. A newborn starts out knowing every shelter its mother knew.

entity.name: CarriedWood
entity.doc: Gets the wood the entity is carrying, from cutting a tree, or zero if its hands are empty. Wood is spent when the entity builds onto its group's shelter, and lost if it dies.

entity.name: WoodForShelter
entity.doc: Gets the number of the shelter the entity cut its wood for, or NoShelter if it is not carrying wood or cut it with no shelter in mind.

entity.name: IsAlive
entity.doc: Gets a value indicating whether the entity is alive, meaning it has not been killed, has energy and warmth remaining, and has not reached its maximum age.

entity.name: IsKilled
entity.doc: Gets a value indicating whether the entity was killed in a fight.

entity.name: TicksDesperate
entity.doc: Gets how many ticks in a row the entity has been desperately hungry, as counted by the conflict system.

entity.name: WeakenedUntilTick
entity.doc: Gets the tick before which the entity is still weakened from its last fight. It fights at reduced strength while the current tick is below this value.
